name: AQR Data Sets
history_start: Varies; time series momentum from 1985-01, Century of Factor Premia goes back about 100 years.
what_it_has: Factor return series from AQR papers. Time Series Momentum covers 58 futures and forwards including currencies; Century of Factor Premia has value, momentum, carry and defensive returns across six asset classes; Value and Momentum Everywhere includes currencies.
simple: A big investment firm posts the results of its research, including how simple currency strategies would have done over many years.
license_terms: AQR's site terms forbid reproducing, distributing or publishing any information from the site without written consent, with no carve out for personal use. Use for private comparison only. https://www.aqr.com/Terms-of-Use
quality_notes: Series are rebuilt and updated on different schedules (TSMOM last updated 2026-05-29, Century of Factor Premia 2026-02-27). Returns are AQR's own constructions and gross of real costs.

relevance.reason: Ready made currency carry, value and trend return series to compare our results against.
